name: AvePoint, Inc. Class A Common Stock
description: AvePoint Inc is a provider of modern data protection, enabling organizations to secure, govern, and operationalize data at scale across cloud ecosystems. Customers rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation as it adopt cloud collaboration and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven developed tools and workflows. Its products and services are sold throughout the world, through direct and indirect sales channels.
